text: Your arms look small because your forearms are weak. You can do curls. You can do push-ups. You can bench all you want. But if your grip fails first, your arms never grow. Let me fix that. You only need two moves. First, dead hangs. Grab a bar and hang. Simple. [music] Until 20 seconds in. This builds crushing grip strength and hits every forearm muscle at once. Second, reverse curls. Pronated grip. Curl it up. This targets the brachioraiialis, the muscle that makes your arm look thick from the side. No fancy exercises. No useless pump, just real forearm growth and arms that finally look
